hadith:
Khusoomaat - Narrated Jabir:

A man manumitted a slave and he had no other property than that, so the Prophet (ﷺ) canceled the manumission (and sold the slave for him). Nu'aim bin Al-Nahham bought the slave from him.
message: Embrace patience and kindness in all interactions, especially with those close to us, reflecting the divine attributes of Al Haleem. Remember that true faith involves supporting fellow believers and showing compassion, as exemplified in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Let these principles guide our actions and strengthen our connection to God.
name:
Al Haleem - الْحَلِيمُ - The Forebearing

The name Al Haleem originates from the Arabic root 'H-L-M', which conveys the meaning of gentleness and forbearance. In the Quran, Allah is described as Al Haleem, emphasizing His patience and restraint towards His creation, even when they commit sins. This attribute encourages believers to embody patience and understanding in their own lives.
verse:
